angehalten.bremse: Paused: more than {anzahl} runs in one minute. Check the trigger and switch the automation on again.
angehalten.wiederherstellung: Paused after a restore. Check the automation and switch it on again.
angehalten.typ-unbekannt: Paused: the folder type “{typ}” doesn’t exist in this Library. Without it the automation would run on all folder types – it stays off until the type exists or you adjust it.
karte.aufgabe.an-admins_one: {anzahl} recipient is deactivated and has no stand-in – the task now has no recipient.
karte.aufgabe.an-admins_other: {anzahl} recipients are deactivated and have no stand-in – the tasks now have no recipient.
karte.aufgabe.leer: The task text is empty after filling in the placeholders.
karte.aufgabe.niemand: Nobody gets the task: there is no active person for the recipients.
karte.aufgabe.niemand-ereignis: Nothing to do: the event names no person (e.g. absence without a stand-in).
karte.aufgabe.ohne-leserecht_one: {anzahl} of them may not see the folder: the task arrives but only shows a notice. The Workbench shows this under Tasks.
karte.aufgabe.ohne-leserecht_other: {anzahl} of them may not see the folder: the tasks arrive but only show a notice. The Workbench shows this under Tasks.
karte.aufgabe.ohne-mappe: “Task” needs a folder (the folder no longer exists or is in the bin).
karte.aufgabe.trocken.nicht-sichtbar_one: {namen} may not see everything – it says “(not visible)” there.
karte.aufgabe.trocken.nicht-sichtbar_oth: {namen} may not see everything – it says “(not visible)” there.
karte.aufgabe.trocken.ohne-leserecht_one: {namen} may not see the folder and would only get a notice with the due date.
karte.aufgabe.trocken.ohne-leserecht_oth: {namen} may not see the folder and would only get a notice with the due date.
karte.aufgabe.vorhanden_one: {anzahl} person already has a deadline for this date (no second one).
karte.aufgabe.vorhanden_other: {anzahl} people already have a deadline for this date (no second one).
karte.feld.ohne-mappe: “Change field” needs a folder (the folder no longer exists or is in the bin).
karte.stopp.ergebnis: After this, no further automations run for this event.
konflikt: Someone has changed this automation in the meantime. Reload it and apply your changes again.
konto.fehlt: The system account “Automation” is not set up.
lauf.abgebrochen: Cancelled: the server was stopped during the run.
lauf.anderer-typ: The folder now has a different folder type.
lauf.gestoppt: Skipped by “{name}” (No further automations after this).
lauf.kette: Skipped: automations trigger each other at most {tiefe} times in a row.
lauf.nicht-lesbar: Skipped: the system account “Automation” may not read this folder.
lauf.zeit: Cancelled: the run took longer than {s} seconds.
loeschen.herkunft: Automations from Ablago or a package can only be switched off. Copy them to make your own from them.
rechte.warnung: This automation can’t run: the account “Automation” may not see folders of the type “{typ}”.
platzhalter.zeitraum.offen: from now until the absence ends
test.mappe: Please choose a folder for the test run.
test.rechte: The automation may not see this folder (permissions on the folder type “{typ}”).
test.typ: For the test run, please choose a folder of the type “{typ}”.
ui.beschreibung: When something happens and the conditions are met, Ablago does something by itself.
ui.dann.leer: No card yet: what should happen? Drag a card here or choose one below.
ui.karte.dann.aufgabe.frist: With “Date reached” the task becomes a deadline for the folder’s date: it completes itself when the date is changed or cleared.
ui.karte.dann.aufgabe.rechte: Whoever may not see the folder gets the task without a link, on their own user folder.
ui.karte.dann.feld.ohne-typ: “Change field” needs a folder type in the When card.
ui.karte.dann.stopp.text: After this, no further automations run for this event (those with a higher number in the order).
ui.kopiert: Copied – the copy is switched off.
ui.leer: No automation yet. Create one with “+ New”.
ui.liste.gruppe_other: {anzahl} automations, one after another in this order
ui.loeschen.text: The automation and its history disappear. Switching it off is enough if you only want to pause it.
ui.name: Name
ui.position: runs as {nr} of {anzahl} for the same trigger
ui.rechte.link: View permissions on the folder type
ui.trocken.hilfe: In a dry run Ablago only shows what would happen – nothing is changed and nobody is notified.
ui.uebersicht.fehlgeschlagen.text: Look at the cause and retry the run.
ui.umgezogen_one: A reminder of a deadline is now an automation.
ui.umgezogen_other: {anzahl} reminders of deadlines are now automations.
ui.umgezogen.text: Everything reminds as before – you now set lead time, recipients and text here yourself. The automations are called “Reminder: …”.
ui.und.leer: Without a condition, the automation runs for every matching event.
ui.und.nicht.hilfe: Invert: applies if the condition doesn’t apply
ui.verlauf.name: Name
ui.version.text: This becomes version {neu}; nothing is lost – the current state stays as its own version in the change history.
ui.vorrat.hinweis: Drag a card to its area or click it. By keyboard: “+ Card” in the area.
ui.waehlen: Choose an automation on the left or create one with “+ New”.
ui.wenn.datum.text: Once a day at the chosen time: for every folder whose date field has been reached after the lead time (months are calendar months; 0 = on the day itself, negative = that long afterwards). Missed days are caught up. A task from it is a deadline: it completes itself when the date is changed or cleared, and the same person gets only one per date.
ui.wenn.felder: Only if one of these fields was changed (empty = any change)
ui.wenn.angelegt.hilfe: Also runs for new folders of this type – e.g. “new post or ‘To’ changed”.
ui.wenn.hinweis: Exactly one When card: event or date.
ui.wenn.wiederholung.hilfe: suggests the next date after completion
ui.wiedergeben.leer: No folder of the type “{typ}” that the automation may see.
ui.wiedergeben.ohne-typ: To try it out, the When card needs a folder type.
ui.wiedergeben.text: Try it out with a folder as if the event had happened. In a dry run Ablago only shows what would happen. Only folders the automation may see are offered.
und.ohne-mappe: Without a folder, the conditions can’t be checked.
wiederholen.nicht: Only failed runs can be retried.
frist.name: Reminder: {feld} ({typ})
vertretung.name: Stand-in entered
vertretung.beschreibung: Taken over from the built-in stand-in task: whoever is entered as a stand-in gets a task. It completes itself when the absence ends or the stand-in changes.
vertretung.text: You have been entered as the stand-in for {benutzer} – {zeitraum}.
post.name: Post for you
post.beschreibung: Taken over from the built-in task “Post for you”: whoever is entered under “To” on new post gets a task – their stand-in when they are away. It completes itself as soon as the post is assigned or done, or goes to someone else. The “Notifications” package replaces it as long as you change nothing.
frist.text: Taken over from the reminder on the field – lead time, recipients and text as before. You set them here yourself.
karte.anmeldeschutz.fehlt: Sign-in protection is not set up here.
karte.paket.nur-eigenes: An automation supplied with a package only calls its own package.
karte.paket.ohne-zeitplan: “Run package on schedule” only runs with the When card “Schedule” (not “for every user”).
karte.paket.nicht-installiert: Package “{paket}” is not installed – nothing to do.
karte.paket.ohne-ereignis: Package “{name}” does not accept schedules – nothing to do.
karte.paket.ergebnis: Ran package “{name}” for {datum} (task: {aufgabe}) – it works with its own rights.
paket.nur-eigenes: An automation supplied with a package only calls its own package – another one cannot be chosen here.
paket.ohne-zeitplan: Package “{name}” does not accept schedules (the event zeitplan.ausgefuehrt is missing in the package).
karte.anmeldeschutz.gesendet: Reported to everyone who manages sign-in protection.
karte.anmeldeschutz.trocken: Would report to everyone who manages sign-in protection.
karte.favoriten.niemand: Nobody to notify (switched off, not in the chosen roles or without read access).
karte.favoriten.ohne-mappe: “Report favourite changes” needs a folder (the folder no longer exists or is in the bin).
karte.favoriten.trocken: Would notify everyone who has the folder as a favourite (and is in the chosen roles).
karte.zusammenfassung.abbestellt: {name} has unsubscribed from the summary under My account.
karte.zusammenfassung.fehler: The summary to {name} couldn’t be sent.
karte.zusammenfassung.fehlt: The daily summary isn’t set up here (no email sending).
karte.zusammenfassung.kein-versand: Email sending is not set up (Workbench → Email and address).
karte.zusammenfassung.ohne-adresse: {name} has no email address or is deactivated.
karte.zusammenfassung.ohne-benutzer: “Send daily summary” needs a user – the When card “Schedule” for each user.
umzug.beschreibung: Taken over from the previous settings under “Notifications and tasks” or “Sign-in protection” – same values, same contents. The “Notifications” package replaces them as long as you change nothing.
ui.ohne-benachrichtigungen.text: Nobody gets the daily summary, favourites report no changes, and new post creates no “Post for you” task. The “Notifications” package brings all of this as automations.
ui.ohne-post-fuer-dich.text: New post for someone no longer appears under their “To do”: no automation that is switched on creates the task. Update the “Notifications” package (1.3.0 or later) or switch on “Post for you”.
ui.wenn.zeitplan.feiertage: Not on public holidays (federal state from the daily summary setting)
ui.wenn.zeitplan.je-benutzer: For each user – runs once per person; the cards have their user folder and {benutzer}
ui.wenn.zeitplan.profilzeit: Time, weekdays and public holidays from the user’s “My account” (like the daily summary)
ui.wenn.zeitplan.text: If Ablago was off at that time, it catches up on the same day – not on following days.
ui.karte.dann.zusammenfassung.text: Sends the user of the run their open tasks by email – like the daily summary before. Anyone who has unsubscribed under My account, is absent or has nothing open gets nothing.
ui.karte.dann.favoriten.text: Everyone who has the folder as a favourite and wants to be notified gets a bundled notification “Changed”. Anyone can switch it off under My account.
ui.karte.dann.favoriten.rollen: Only to members of these roles
ui.karte.dann.favoriten.rollen.hilfe: No role chosen: to everyone. Anyone outside sees no switch for favourites under My account.
ui.karte.dann.favoriten.vorgabe.hilfe: Without the tick it starts switched off for new users; they switch it on themselves under My account. Existing users keep their setting.
ui.karte.dann.paket.fest: Supplied with a package: this automation only calls its own package. You set time and days in the When card.
ui.karte.dann.paket.text: The package learns that the schedule has been reached (with date and task) and then works with its own rights – the card gives it no additional ones.
ui.karte.dann.anmeldeschutz.sammel: Digest of the locks before today
ui.karte.dann.anmeldeschutz.konto: Account lock immediately to everyone who manages sign-in protection
ui.karte.dann.anmeldeschutz.sammel.text: Email to everyone who manages sign-in protection, only if there were locks since the last report (When card “Schedule”).
ui.karte.dann.anmeldeschutz.konto.text: Email to everyone who manages sign-in protection, at most once a day per account (When card “User account locked”).
ui.karte.und.merkmal: Library is also used for work
vorlage.fehlt: This automation template does not exist (any more).
vorlage.bremse.offen: You already have {anzahl} planned runs on this folder. Complete or delete one first.
vorlage.bremse.minute: More than {anzahl} in one minute – please wait a moment and try again.
vorlage.anderer-typ: “{name}” is not available for this folder type.
vorlage.angehalten.person: Paused: the person who set up this run no longer exists or is not a user. It never runs under a system account.
vorlage.angehalten.deaktiviert: Paused: the person who set up this run is deactivated.
vorlage.angehalten.leserecht: Paused: the person who set up this run may no longer read the folder.
vorlage.angehalten.vorlage: Paused: the template no longer exists.
vorlage.test.niemand: No card has a recipient – nothing happens.
vorlage.test.ohne-leserecht: {name} may not read the folder and would only see a note.
vorlage.loeschen.herkunft: Only your own templates can be deleted. Switch off templates from Ablago and from packages instead.
vorlage.loeschen.offen_one: The template is in use on {anzahl} folder right now – you can delete it once the run has happened or been deleted.
vorlage.loeschen.offen_other: The template is in use on {anzahl} folders right now – you can delete it once the runs have happened or been deleted.
vorlage.zuruecksetzen.nicht: Only templates from Ablago that no package replaces can be reset.
vorlage.ui.beschreibung: Automations with gaps that you apply to one folder – “Assign task”, “Remind”, follow-up. When applied, they ask for recipient, text or date.
vorlage.ui.waehlen: Choose a template on the left.
vorlage.ui.angehalten_one: {anzahl} planned run is paused: the person who set it up may no longer carry it out. Under “In use on” you can resume it or have it deleted on the folder.
vorlage.ui.angehalten_other: {anzahl} planned runs are paused: the people who set them up may no longer carry them out. Under “In use on” you can resume them or have them deleted on the folder.
vorlage.ui.ueberlagert: The package “{paket}” replaces Ablago’s template. If you remove it, Ablago’s applies again.
vorlage.ui.aus.text: Switched off: it is not in the “Folder” menu. Runs already planned still happen.
vorlage.ui.name: Name
vorlage.ui.reihenfolge.text: 1–99, lower appears higher in the “Folder” menu.
vorlage.ui.typen.text: None chosen: for all folder types.
vorlage.ui.fragen.text: What is asked appears in the small dialog on the folder. The text goes into a card with {eingabe}.
vorlage.ui.karten.text: Only tasks and notifications – to people who may read the folder (otherwise they only see a note). Ablago fills placeholders with the recipient’s rights.
vorlage.ui.loeschen.text: The template disappears from the “Folder” menu. Its history goes with it.
vorlage.ui.ausprobieren.text: Shows on a folder what would happen – with your rights as the person. Nothing is created.
vorlage.ui.benutzt.leer: There are no open runs of this template right now.
vorlage.ui.uebersicht.text: The person who set it up is deactivated or may no longer read the folder. It only runs once you resume it – with their rights at that time.
